intermediate.title: Sprint | 1st passage of the finish line (100 km)

story: Alex Aranburu (Cofidis) won Stage 4 of Itzulia Basque Country 2026, edging out Tobias Halland Johannessen in a reduced front group after a relentlessly aggressive day of racing over seven climbs around Galdakao. Meanwhile, race leader Paul Seixas went on the attack late in the stage, extending his overall lead over his general classification rivals.
